name: Felpaw Village
summary: At Felpaw Village, corrupted furbolgs guard Felwood’s northern path to Timbermaw Hold. Demonic blight has turned the settlement against all outsiders.

sections.title: A Stronghold of Corruption
sections.body: Corrupted Deadwood furbolgs hold Felwood’s northern edge at Felpaw Village. Once gentle wardens of the forest, they fell to the demonic blight unleashed during the Third War and became feral. Crude huts and ritual totems fill their blighted enclave. Near the tunnel entrance to Timbermaw Hold, hostile warriors attack anyone who comes close.

sections.title: A Thorn Beside Timbermaw Hold
sections.body: At Felwood’s northern mouth, Timbermaw guards watch over the few uncorrupted furbolgs left in the region. They mourn their fallen cousins, yet keep their guard. The Deadwood threaten the passage to Timbermaw Hold and could carry corruption through its gates into Moonglade and Winterspring. So the guards call on travelers to thin their ranks and seize their ritual fetishes.

faq.answer: Deadwood furbolgs live in Felpaw Village. Demonic corruption spreading across Felwood has overtaken the local tribe.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here hostile?
faq.answer: Demonic energies poisoning Felwood’s soil, water, and wildlife drove the Deadwood furbolgs mad. They see outsiders as enemies and cannot be reasoned with.
Felpaw Village lies at Felwood’s far northern end, along the road to Timbermaw Hold’s main southern entrance.

faq.q: How does Felpaw Village relate to Timbermaw Hold?
faq.answer: The uncorrupted Timbermaw watch Felpaw Village from their nearby gates. The Deadwood threaten the passage between Felwood, Winterspring, and Moonglade. The Timbermaw reward outsiders who thin the village’s hostile ranks and recover Deadwood ritual feathers.

angles.text: As a druid devoted to restoring the natural order, you may see the fallen Deadwood of Felpaw Village as a tragic reminder of the Legion’s lingering poison in sacred forests.
Night Elves once counted the furbolgs as steadfast allies. For you, the Deadwood’s madness and ritual debasement at Felpaw make that loss especially bitter.
